entries.note: The first row, at the clock of the guide's receipt date, when the branch writes the guide; its comment says the parcel waits for collection.
Received at the distribution centre; some histories go straight to the bag.
Put in a bag for the trip; the comment numbers the consolidation and the bag.
On the night trip to the destination branch, where the pickup row follows; the comment is a date. Not a courier's delivery round.
Waiting at the destination branch for collection, often written two or three times in a few seconds; the comment gives the branch and shelf, at times a person's name.
Waiting on a shelf of a branch's warehouse to be handed over, before a handover to a third party.
Collected; the comment names who took the parcel and their identity card number, which the adapter does not read.
Handed to someone other than the recipient, whom the comment names.
